name: Exploding Fruit Trap
source: Starfinder Society Scenario #1-11: Friends of the Forest
description: A makeshift catapult launches a dozen twi-lw fruits at all creatures in a wide area when a creature enters a selected 5ft Square.
disable: DC 14 Survival or DC 14 Thievery to disable the triggering pressure plate.

offensiveAbilities.name: Bombs Away!
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the designated square

Effect The catapult launches a dozen twi-lw fruits through the air, dealing 2d4 Bludgeoning Damage damage to the triggering creature and all creatures in a 5ft Type:emanation centered on the triggering creature. Targeted creatures can attempt a Basic DC 16 Reflex Saving Throw save. A creature that fails their save is additionally coated in sticky fruit, becoming Clumsy 1 for 1d4 rounds (1 minute on a critical failure).
